title: Autocar, LLC: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel (1,339 affected)

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire (9,048 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Audi) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Q4 E-Tron and Q4 Sportback E-Tron vehicles. The high voltage battery may fail and cause a fire.

title: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC: Heater Hose May Rupture and Leak (8 affected)
summary: Daimler Trucks North America, LLC (DTNA) is recalling certain Thomas Built Buses 2027 Saf-T-Liner C2 school buses. The heater hose may rupture, which can result in hot coolant leaking inside the passenger compartment.

title: General Motors, LLC: Insufficient Welds on Front Seats (4 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2026 Chevrolet Traverse, and GMC Acadia vehicles. The driver or front passenger seat may not have sufficient welds where the seat back recliner pivot mechanism attaches to a bracket on the seat frame.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Engine Starter Positive Battery Connection May Loosen (45 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC is recalling certain 2018 740Le xDrive, 2018-2020 530e iPerformance, and 2018-2020 530e xDrive vehicles. The postive battery cable on the engine starter may loosen.

title: Koenigsegg Automotive AB: Unintended Vehicle Movement from Disengaged Electronic Parking Brake (7 affected)
summary: Koenigsegg Automotive AB (Koenigsegg) is recalling certain 2025-2026 CC850 vehicles. The electronic parking brake may not engage properly when the vehicle is in reverse, allowing in unintended vehicle movement.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Wheel May Detach (17 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Venue, Elantra N, Elantra Hybrid, and Elantra vehicles. The wheel lug nuts may loosen and allow the wheel to detach.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Loss of Steering Control From Loose Fasteners (24 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2026 Tucson Hybrid and Elantra vehicles. The front strut assembly fasteners may not be tightened properly, which can result in a loss of vehicle steering control.

title: Great Dane Trailers: Trailer Landing Gear Assembly Welds May Fail (840 affected)
summary: Great Dane Trailers (Great Dane) is recalling certain landing gear assemblies with part number A30300240001. The trailer landing gear k-brace welds may fail, resulting in the landing gear collapsing.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Seat Back May Unlatch During Crash (228,367 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2022-2026 Sienna Hybrid  7-passenger vehicles. The second-row seat backs may fail to remain secured in the event of a crash.

title: Ford Motor Company: Tailgate Cable May Fail (30,123 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2026-2027 F-150, 2026 F-250 SD, F-350 SD, and F-450 SD vehicles. The left-side tailgate cable may fail under certain heavy load conditions.

title: Mack Trucks, Inc.: Hill Start Assist Message Incorrectly Enabled (151 affected)
summary: Mack Trucks, Inc. (Mack) is recalling certain 2024-2026 Medium-Duty Electric (MDe) vehicles that were incorrectly manufactured with the hill start assist (HSA) message enabled.

title: Cummins, Inc.: Driveline May Separate (206 affected)
summary: Cummins, Inc. (Cummins) is recalling certain Meritor drivelines with model numbers RPL20, RPL25, RPL10, RPL35, RPL14, and 176MXL. The drivelines may be missing a snap ring in the slip yoke assembly, causing the bearing cup to separate from the driveline.
